purpose: Compose readable operational activity and evidence-oriented audit history from the same trace foundation without treating the concepts as identical.

useWhen: users need a readable narrative of operational changes
evidence requires actor, timestamp, object, result, and state-change trace
avoidWhen: the surface is only a transient notification list
immutable audit requirements are being simulated without a consumer-owned evidence source

responsive.desktop: Keep a readable ordered feed beside current object context when useful.
responsive.tablet: Move the trace below current work while preserving event order.
responsive.mobile: Use one chronological column with actor, action, and timestamp kept together.

accessibility: Use ordered-list semantics for chronological narrative.
Keep timestamps and actor labels available as text.
Do not represent result only with color or icon.
operational.aiGuidance: Use ActivityFeed for readable activity; add evidence-oriented fields when the consumer is presenting an audit trail, and do not claim immutability from UI alone.
antiPatterns: Treating activity and audit as identical product concepts
Claiming immutable audit behavior from fixture presentation
